params.name: experience_level
params.description: Filter by experience level (e.g., Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced)

params.name: project_length
params.description: Filter by project length (e.g., Hours, Days, Weeks, Months)

params.name: bounty_type
params.description: Filter by bounty type (e.g., Bug, Feature, Security)

params.name: bounty_owner_address
params.description: Filter by Ethereum address of the bounty owner

params.name: is_open
params.description: Filter by whether the bounty is open

params.name: github_url
params.description: Filter by GitHub URL. Can be a comma-separated list of GitHub URLs.

params.name: pk
params.description: Return a single bounty by its primary key ID

params.name: order_by
params.description: Order results by a field key. Prefix with '-' for descending order (e.g., -expires_date)

items.docs: Returns a list of bounties with their current status. Supports filtering by experience level, project length, bounty type, owner address, open status, and GitHub URL.
